text:
Sam Bennett scored three goals and set up the winner, and the Panthers beat Buffalo 4-3 on a night when the Sabres had the better chances for long stretches. Florida is still waiting on Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand, both described by Paul Maurice as close to returning. Bennett made sure the wait didn't cost them.

Buffalo owned the first period, 1.51 to 0.94 in expected goals (the quality of the chances each team got). Bennett scored first anyway, three minutes in, before Jiri Kulich tied it on a 40% chance from Zach Benson and Tage Thompson. Jack Quinn put the Sabres ahead early in the second after, in The Athletic's Matthew Fairburn's words, a couple of shifts with the Panthers "hemmed in their own end." Bennett tied it 18 seconds later. Alex Lyon made a couple of big saves late in the second to keep it 2-2.

Bennett's third goal came shorthanded, 48 seconds into the third. Thompson answered with a shot our numbers gave just a 2% chance; Fairburn clocked it at 90.7 miles per hour. With 3:18 left, Sandis Vilmanis, set up by Bennett and Seth Jones, scored the winner, moving Florida's win chances from 52% to 91%.

The numbers split the way the game felt. Florida outshot Buffalo 30 to 19 and out-attempted them 65 to 41, but the Sabres had 3.08 expected goals to the Panthers' 2.59, and our replays gave Buffalo the win 59% of the time. Kulich alone took six shots worth 1.31 expected goals and scored once. Jacob Markstrom saved about what his shots deserved, including a third-period stop on Josh Doan, while Lyon allowed 1.4 goals more than his.

That's the hard part for Lyon. Joe Yerdon noted after the game that Lyon is now 0-3-1 and still looking for his first win, and Fairburn called it a tough one to let slip against a division opponent. Buffalo had ended a five-game skid with a 6-3 win in Washington and beat Florida 5-3 in October. This time the better process ran into a center with four points. Bennett took four shots worth 0.47 expected goals and turned three of them into goals, a finishing night that won't repeat often, but it counted.
headline: Bennett's hat trick gives Panthers the late edge
